title: Larry and Ron Tototz in their quarters
description: Larry (left) and his bunk mate Ron Tototz (right) inside their quarters — woven-matting walls, a shelf of personal items, a footlocker between them. Taken moments apart from VN-0002, in the same sitting.
researchNotes: Identified by Larry's son (giscus comment, 2026-08-13, discussion #30): 'Left: Larry Hunnewell / Right: Ron Tototz' — confirming the pair matches VN-0002, where Larry identified the same two men himself ('Left is me / Right: Ron Tototz'). The date carries over from Larry's dating of VN-0002 ('been there at least 6 months, guessing Feb or March'). Family-member comments are deliberately not archived as recollections; this identification lives here in the catalog record instead.
